intent_en: To illustrate the relative volume of all water on Earth compared to the total volume of the planet.
narration_support: All the water on Earth has about this volume compared to Earth.
chart_support: A bubble chart comparing a large circle labeled 'EARTH' with a significantly smaller circle labeled 'ALL THE WATER ON EARTH' to show scale.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly sets up a volume comparison, and the visual uses relative circle sizes to depict the vast difference between the Earth's total volume and its water volume.
